reply.text:
I'd skip the 24 hours without water. Cutting water entirely doesn't make you look leaner, and it can leave you flat, dizzy and weak on the day. That's the opposite of what you want in front of a camera, and it's a risk I won't coach you into.

What helps most on the day is the boring stuff. Eat normally in the days before, keep your sodium steady instead of swinging it, and sip water through the day rather than chugging or avoiding it. Nailing your sleep and keeping your last hard session a day or two out also helps.

If you're thinking about anything more aggressive than that, like diuretics or an extreme water cut, that's one for a doctor, since I can't give amounts or approve it. If you tell me the shoot date and how you normally train, I can build the training side so you walk in fresh.
